images.scene: Robinson sits inside his shelter on a rainy day, leaning close to a green parrot perched on his hand, coaxing it to speak while it says its name; tools and clay lie nearby.
images.alt: A man indoors teaching a green parrot perched on his hand to speak.

images.scene: Robinson kneels beside a pile of clay pots and pipkins stacked one upon another, feeding firewood into the blazing embers heaped all around them until the pots glow red-hot.
images.alt: A man tends a large open fire heaped around a stack of glowing clay pots.

images.scene: Robinson bakes barley loaves on his tiled hearth, having whelmed a broad earthen pot over the dough and drawn the glowing embers up all around its outside to keep in the heat.
images.alt: A man bakes loaves under an upturned earthen pot surrounded by hot embers on a hearth.

images.scene: On a rough sandy beach ridge, Robinson digs away the sand beneath the ship's boat, which lies turned almost bottom-upward, wedging levers and rollers under it to try to shift it toward the sea.
images.alt: A man digs sand from under an overturned boat on a beach, using wooden levers.

images.scene: In a forest clearing Robinson stands beside the huge dugout periagua he carved from one great cedar tree, big enough for many men, stranded far from the distant creek it cannot reach.
images.alt: A man stands next to an enormous dugout canoe carved from a single tree in the woods.

images.scene: Robinson walks across the island in the blazing midday sun wearing a goatskin cap and rough goatskin clothes with the hair outward, holding up a large skin-covered umbrella that shades him like a pent-house.
images.alt: A man in goatskin clothes and cap walks in bright sun holding a fur-covered umbrella.
